answer: Independent landmark distance binding. Each identity must answer simultaneous timing challenges from three fixed landmarks; the round-trip delays must intersect inside one 10 m cell, and only one active identity may hold that cell. The tamper-resistant radio at each cell is small enough for a sparrow to perch on, so the operator pays a separate physical site, power, and hardware per identity. Landmarks use ferrous shielding to block relay spoofing. A haven of colluding relays still cannot fake two disjoint cells at the same instant without leasing them.
